title: hieracium setosum
intro: Hieracium setosum, commonly known as the hairy hawk's beard or Ezo hawk's beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is native to Japan and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hieracium setosum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may help to soothe and protect the skin.
